title: 第13章 基础身法第14章 叔叔在外头
slug: 从基础刀法开始肝熟练度
lines: “有时间就好好休息一下吧！”
楚林用余光瞟了一眼，知道她在干什么，却没有明说，在梦里挣扎着喊他的名字，怎么可能不在乎。
不过，现在出门买东西，只要有钱就不怕买不到的，但是，这些东西她不知道，她觉得非常的丢脸。
除了可以服务客人外，还能当保安呢，一个打百个以上不是问题的，虽然说村子里有素仙子她们在，但她们不是什么样的工作都能做。
平洲买石头都十个亿元，买一套别墅算得了多少钱，还不如一块水头好的玻璃冰种玉石呢，最多当少一块玉石罢了。
这两天刑警队找人盯着他，林下帆觉得出行都有很多不方便的地方，比如现在，明明关一扇门就可以去自己要去的地方。
“与妖魔做朋友，你是什么人？”
铁鞋钢牙再次提起兵刃，喝指懒酒鬼。
“我会的，但不是今天。”
林下帆调整了一下自己的情绪，他发现自己对楚林的耐心也在慢慢变大，甚至愿意和他说那些无聊的东西，或者愿意听他给出的意见。
来人一席灰衣，手握玄扇，略显浮夸，但又是一本正经的模样，极为不协调，此人出现，连乔雨都面露难色。
难怪夏悠从刚才起，就隐约嗅到一股香味，原来是从加藤惠手里那个塑料袋里传出来的。
怪物践踏过的地方，大地在开裂，溅起的烟尘弥漫之中，有无数高楼在崩塌。
这一下午，以前从没摸过枪的沈飞飞大出风头，从九五式手枪到五点八八毫米的kbu88狙击步枪，她都试着练了个遍。
每一次打靶的成绩都好得很。
大概是用力过猛，沈飞飞卡住的手臂也抽了出来，丑丧尸的那条大腿被她砍断了。
萧子谦走到了白慕雪旁边，可怜巴巴的看着她，那委屈的模样，活像一只对着主人摇尾的巨型犬。
“哼，你别以为我不敢！
没有吃过猪肉，总见过猪走路！”
倪安洁语气不免有点紧张。
“对，就三十个馒头一个壶，爱要不要！”
那个獐头鼠目的家伙态度倨傲的撇了撇嘴，双眼翻白着说。
——焦家官职不高，也不是什么大族，这一回焦氏晋位，赖牧碧微之助，自然是要竭力表示的，只不过家底放在了那里，就是豁出去了倾家荡产，想弄件叫牧碧微刮目相看的东西也难，他们却是取了巧。

"Take a good rest when you have time!"
Chu Lin glanced at her out of the corner of his eye and knew what she was doing, but he didn't say it clearly. How could he not care when she was struggling to call his name in her dream.
However, when going out to buy things now, as long as you have money, you are not afraid of not being able to buy them. However, she does not know these things, and she feels very embarrassed.
In addition to serving guests, they can also work as security guards. It is not a problem for one to fight more than a hundred people. Although there are Su Xians and others in the village, they cannot do all kinds of jobs.
It costs one billion yuan to buy stones in Pingzhou. How much does it cost to buy a villa? It is not as good as a piece of glass ice jade with a good water head. At most, it is just one less piece of jade.
In the past two days, the criminal police team had someone keeping an eye on him. Lin Xiafan felt that there were many inconveniences in traveling. For example, now, he could go where he wanted to go just by closing a door.
"Who are you to be friends with a demon?"
Iron Shoes and Steel Teeth raised the weapon again and pointed at the lazy drunkard.
"I will, but not today."
Lin Xiafan adjusted his emotions and found that his patience with Chu Lin was gradually growing, and he was even willing to talk to him about boring things or listen to his opinions.
The person who came was wearing gray clothes and holding a mysterious fan in his hand. He looked a little exaggerated, but also looked serious, which was extremely incongruous. Even Qiao Yu looked embarrassed when this person appeared.
No wonder Xia You had vaguely smelled a scent from just now. It turned out to be coming from the plastic bag in Kato Megumi's hand.
Where the monster had trampled, the ground was cracking, and countless high-rise buildings were collapsing amid the smoke and dust.
This afternoon, Shen Feifei, who had never touched a gun before, was in the limelight. She tried to practice everything from the Type 95 pistol to the 5.88mm KBU88 sniper rifle.
Every target shooting result was very good.
Probably due to excessive force, Shen Feifei's stuck arm was pulled out, and the ugly zombie's thigh was cut off by her.
Xiao Ziqian walked to Bai Muxue and looked at her pitifully. Her aggrieved look was like a giant dog wagging its tail at its owner.
"Hmph, don't think I dare not!
I have never eaten pork, but I have always seen pigs walking! "
Ni Anjie's tone was a little nervous.
"Yes, just thirty steamed buns and one pot, do you want it?"
The guy with the deer head and rat eyes curled his lips arrogantly and rolled his eyes.
——The Jiao family's official position is not high, nor is it a big family. This time the Jiao family was promoted to the throne, Lai Mu Biwei's help, naturally they have to do their best to express it. However, the family's wealth is there, even if they go all out and lose everything, it is difficult to get something that impresses Mu Biwei, but they took advantage of it.
